title: Lazy streams
statement:
What does this code print?

Stream.of(1, 2, 3, 4)
    .filter(x -> { System.out.print("f" + x + " "); return x % 2 == 0; })
    .map(x -> { System.out.print("m" + x + " "); return x * 10; })
    .findFirst();
choices: f1 f2 f3 f4 m2 m4
f1 f2 m2 f3 f4 m4
Nothing: findFirst() is not enough to run the pipeline
